about_the_game:
Serre is an escape game in a small open world, featuring inhabitants trapped inside a greenhouse and a time loop. You must escape from this eternal trap! Will you manage to break free from this cage before the dark night falls? Or will you relive the same day over and over again?

Welcome to the Greenhouse!

What is this strange place? How did you end up here? And why? Every guest is special. Set out to discover this place and make yourself comfortable...

Dark mysteries await you...

How will you escape? Who are the people around you? Get to know them and uncover the secrets they hold. Pay close attention to your surroundings and to the strange phenomena that occur.

Don’t waste time!

Confinement is not your only enemy. The more time passes, the more the night reveals itself... Do not close your eyes, or everything will start over again. The eternal loop is here to keep you trapped...

A unique experience!

Serre is a 3D real-time puzzle and mystery game developed by a solo developer. This game will test your deduction skills, your powers of observation, and your perseverance.
